verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://www.daytona.io/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key. That is a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a well-known URL, and the agent-skill docs separately confirm a Daytona API exists. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or linking the spec, and evidence of how much of the API it covers and how it is versioned.
